note: Capability register for the platform. `state` describes what exists in THIS repository today, not what a hosted deployment could add. automated=code present, scaffolded=interface present without live data source, blocked=needs an external credential/authority before any value can be produced.

modules.name: Product research
modules.purpose: Find candidate ASINs and resolve each to an authoritative catalog record before anything is written about it.
official_inputs: Creators API SearchItems / GetItems / GetBrowseNodes (S07, S08)
modules.verification: An ASIN must pass the 10-character identifier check AND return a catalog record keyed to the same ASIN; otherwise the candidate is dropped to the flag queue with no attributes recorded.
modules.hard_rule: Identity is never inferred from a slug, short link, filename, or human description. This is the exact failure mode observed in the three submitted links (see Flagged for Review).
blockers: No Associates account or API credentials in this workspace

modules.name: Trend & demand detection
modules.purpose: Rank niches by demand trajectory instead of intuition.
official_inputs: Browse node / best-seller movement and sales-rank deltas returned by the catalog API (S07)
Associates Reports for revenue-side signal (S02)
modules.verification: A trend row may only exist if two dated, sourced observations of the same metric exist; a single snapshot cannot create a trend.
modules.hard_rule: No "trending product", search-volume, or popularity figure is stated anywhere on this site, because no authorized data source was reachable to verify one.
blockers: Requires an authenticated catalog feed with >=2 dated snapshots

modules.name: Pricing analysis
modules.purpose: Track price point, discount depth and offer shape per ASIN for editorial context and comparison integrity.
official_inputs: Creators API offer/price data only, displayed with the fetch timestamp (S02, S07)
implemented_in: tools/amazon_creators_api.py (stores price with as_of + response hash)
tools/build_site.py (renders price cells only when as_of exists)
modules.verification: Rendered prices must trace to a stored API response file whose hash matches; a stale or hand-typed price fails the build.
modules.hard_rule: Displaying prices outside Amazon-served links or API data violates the Participation Requirements (R-04), so every price cell on this site is intentionally blank.
blockers: No API credentials; no cached offer records

modules.name: Review analysis
modules.purpose: Summarise recurring praise/complaint themes to write an honest review, and to surface objections a buying guide must answer.
official_inputs: Only review data the API License permits to be used and displayed (S02, S03)
implemented_in: content/templates/buying_guide.md.tmpl (objection blocks stay empty until sourced)
modules.verification: Theme claims require a cited, dated dataset; sentiment numbers without a sample size are rejected by the linter.
modules.hard_rule: Customer review text may not be altered or inserted into (R-10); star ratings may not be shown outside the API licence; and this project has neither, so no rating appears.
blockers: No permitted review dataset in this workspace

modules.name: Competition assessment
modules.purpose: Estimate how contested a keyword/niche is, so effort goes where a new page can actually rank.
official_inputs: Search result and result-count mechanics are not an official program source; only SERP-level analysis (indexed pages, review depth of ranking documents) is used, recorded with its own source per row
modules.verification: Competition rows are only populated by an operator-observed SERP sample stored in data/; each row must carry observation date and the query used.
modules.hard_rule: The scoring model returns an explicit "insufficient data" result rather than a default score; a missing input never silently becomes 0 or 5.
blockers: No SERP dataset was collected for this build

modules.name: Commission & revenue modelling
modules.purpose: Attach the correct published rate to a verified category and compute expected value with the real attribution mechanics.
official_inputs: Standard Commission Income Statement Table 1 (S04)
Session / 24h, 89-day cart, 180-day ship rules (S02)
payment timing and minimums (S02)
modules.verification: The rate table is transcribed row-by-row from the official page and re-read each cycle; any category absent from the official table falls to "All Other Categories" and is labelled as such.
modules.hard_rule: Rate figures are only ever Amazon's published figures. Conversion/traffic inputs are operator assumptions and are printed as assumptions, never as results.

modules.name: SEO content generation
modules.purpose: Produce product articles, comparisons, and buying guides that are policy-clean by construction.
official_inputs: Google structured-data requirements for Product/Review/Offer and pros & cons (S14, S15)
rel="sponsored" for affiliate links (S12, S13)
Amazon Content/claims rules (R-06, R-10)
modules.verification: Generator refuses to emit a draft for any entry whose identity is unverified; lint suite checks disclosure proximity, banned strings, claim evidence, JSON-LD validity, rel attributes, and empty-placeholder leakage.
modules.hard_rule: Unresolved fields render as an explicit UNVERIFIED placeholder that the linter then fails on - so a half-verified article cannot reach the publish directory.

modules.name: Publishing & link management
modules.purpose: Own the link surface: canonical URL, tag, disclosure placement, and a per-page campaign identifier.
official_inputs: Special Link/tag rules and SiteStripe or API-based link creation (S02, S03, S09)
sub-tag rules incl. the no-per-user-association prohibition (R-08)
modules.verification: Every emitted link is re-parsed and asserted to carry the tag, the Amazon host, and rel="sponsored nofollow"; sub-tag values come from a static registry, never from request data.
modules.hard_rule: No live affiliate link is published from this repository: without an approved Associates ID, the builder emits only an inert preview marked `NO_TAG - NOT FOR PUBLICATION`.
blockers: No Associates ID / tracking ID supplied

modules.name: Click & conversion tracking
modules.purpose: Measure what a page does, while keeping Amazon's earnings truth in Associates Central.
official_inputs: Associates reporting is the only source of earnings and conversion figures (S02, R-15)
Amazon may record information about users clicking through Special Links (S01 Sec. 12)
modules.verification: Site-side metrics are first-party click counts only, keyed to page+campaign; conversion/earnings columns stay blank until a dated Associates report is ingested.
modules.hard_rule: Zero clicks, CTR, conversion rate, EPC, or revenue number is displayed anywhere in this build - none exists to verify. The tracker also stores no user identifier, to respect R-08 and privacy law.
blockers: No hosted endpoint; no Associates earnings/report export

modules.name: Campaign optimization loop
modules.purpose: Reallocate effort: retire losing pages, duplicate winning angles, re-test placement.
official_inputs: Minimum observability requirements are the operator's own statistics plan; no external rule is invented here
implemented_in: tools/optimize.py (rule engine: no-action until n>=30 clicks AND a dated earnings report exists; decisions recorded with the evidence they used)
modules.verification: Each proposed action must name the input rows behind it; actions without evidence are not emitted.
modules.hard_rule: The optimizer cannot conclude "this niche converts" from thin data, and cannot rewrite product facts - it only changes placement, internal linking, and coverage.

modules.name: Niche discovery
modules.purpose: Score a category before committing content budget to it.
official_inputs: Published commission bands and 0.00% exclusions (S04) as a hard eligibility filter; catalog-side demand signals as the ranking input
modules.verification: Eligibility filter is deterministic and sourced (a 0.00% band disqualifies a niche regardless of demand); the ranking term is empty until demand data exists, so no niche is declared profitable here.
modules.hard_rule: The site lists the method and the exclusion rule, not a shortlist of "best niches", because that would be an unverifiable claim.

modules.name: Scalability & automation substrate
modules.purpose: Run the loop continuously and cheaply: schedule, cache, backoff, idempotent build, deploy gate.
official_inputs: GitHub Pages as the static host (this repository's own workflow)
API operation quotas/limits as published by the API docs (S07)
modules.verification: Build is deterministic (same inputs -> same bytes), network-free, and each deploy re-runs the data/verification lints; a failed lint stops publication.
modules.hard_rule: No crawler/scrape path exists as a fallback - the only accepted ingestion is the official API, because scraping is both brittle and outside the program rules.
blockers: Scheduled execution needs a runner/secret configuration
